name: Die Sendung mit der Maus
description: The children's show has been a fixed Sunday morning ritual in German living rooms since 1971. Not only children, but also many adults sit in front of the television every week when the clever orange mouse, his blue elephant buddy and the yellow duck lead the way with short, funny cartoon clips between the "funny and factual stories".

videos.title: How is an ICE built?
videos.overview:
In this Sachgeschichte, Armin and his team travel across the country to Poland and Austria to see how a brand new ICE 4 is being built.

Armin accompanies the train from the first sheet of metal to the scheduled inaugural journey and even gets behind the wheel himself.

videos.title: The Sun, the Moon and the Earth
videos.overview: Sun, Moon, and Earth: Why is it warm in summer while we freeze in winter? Where do the seasons even come from, and what makes the days longer? Astronaut Alexander Gerst answers these and other everyday questions in the German children's program "Die Sendung mit der Maus" (The Show with the Mouse)
